one_line_description: Gladly is an agentic commerce platform that provides a conversational commerce experience for customers, with features like AI-powered chatbots, customer memory, and unified inbox.
auth_notes: Gladly uses HTTP Basic auth with a user's email and an API token for authentication.
gate_detail: Gladly provides a self-serve interface for users to manage their accounts and access the API.

api_surface.rate_limits: 10 requests per second per HTTP method

evidence.quote_snippet: Gladly is the only retail-trained AI Commerce solution for the modern customer journey.

The Gladly API is a REST API at your own organization's domain (https://yourcompany.gladly.com/api/v1/), authenticated with HTTP Basic auth: the email of a Gladly user who has the API User permission, plus an API token that user creates.
The Model Context Protocol gives AI agents a standard way to call external tools.
